title: Build a Website in 10 Minutes With AI
description:
A no-code plus AI workflow for going from zero to a live, working website in about ten minutes.

#NoCode #AITools #WebDesign

scenes.narration: You don't need to know how to code to have a live website today. Here's the ten minute version.

Start with a no-code website builder that has AI generation built in. Instead of picking a template and filling in blanks, describe what the site is for in a sentence, 'a landing page for a local coffee shop,' and let it generate a full first draft, layout, sections, and placeholder copy included.
Swap out the placeholder text next, that's the part that makes it feel generic if you skip it.

For images, either upload your own or generate a few with an AI image tool using the same style keywords for every image, so the whole site feels visually consistent instead of looking like five different sites stitched together.
Check it on mobile before you publish, most visitors will see it on a phone first, not a laptop.

Once the layout's right, ask the AI assistant to tighten the copy, shorter headlines, clearer call to action buttons, that's usually a bigger improvement than any design tweak you could make manually in the same amount of time.
Then publish. Most of these builders host it for free on a starter domain, so there's nothing stopping you from having it live today instead of someday.
Build one this week, even just for practice. Subscribe for more no-code and AI tutorials.
